attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 11
attributes.name: Entice
attributes.powers:
When you encounter a non-villain, non-henchman monster from a location deck, bury this card to defeat the monster. Then draw an ally from the box and put it on top of your location deck.

After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 13 check to discard this card instead of burying it.
